properties.entry: SELECT A.* FROM TB_GEN_MAN_MNTR_TABLE A join TB_MEMBER B on A.MEMBER_SQNO = B.MEMBER_SQNO WHERE MEMBER_ID = ? AND TABLE_NAME =? ORDER BY GEN_MNTR_SQNO

SELECT MAX(A.GEN_MNTR_SQNO) AS GEN_MNTR_SQNO , A.TABLE_NAME AS TABLE_NAME FROM TB_GEN_MAN_MNTR_TABLE A join TB_MEMBER B on A.MEMBER_SQNO = B.MEMBER_SQNO WHERE MEMBER_ID = ? GROUP BY A.TABLE_NAME ORDER BY MAX(A.GEN_MNTR_SQNO) DESC;
